analysis:
Integration pass over a docs-plus-allowlist PR. Changes: changelog.d/qwen-gdn-prompt-kernel.md; GDN prompt-kernel docs in docs/architecture/hardware-support.md and inference.md (head 595-611); env-var rows in docs/provider/cli-reference.md (line 1741) and docs/reference/configuration.md (line 414); LaunchAgent.swift adds "DARKBLOOM_TTFT_GDN_BLOCKED" to inferencePassthroughEnvKeys (head ~295); and a new test in LaunchAgentRestartTests.swift. The GatedDelta.swift kernel and probe are not in the supplied evidence. Their bit-exactness and fail-closed fallback are unverified contracts, so the claim that T-041 prefix-cache checkpoint bits are unchanged rests on documentation only.

Security assessment: the only executable change is one allowlisted env key forwarded to the provider launchd job. The allowlist stays explicit, and the test asserts unrelated variables (UNRELATED_SECRET) are not forwarded and that the key is absent from WatchdogAgent.passthroughEnvKeys, which avoids widening T-043's surface. The value carries no secret and affects only kernel choice. Operator control of the provider environment is already inside ADV-001/TB-003. Forced packed/rows modes skip the parity check, which is documented as A/B only. That falls under the accepted T-007/T-056 limits, since the operator can already alter outputs. There is no change to attestation, App Attest authorization, coordinator protocol, key custody or encryption. Cache storage, HMAC naming, TTL and salt scoping (T-041) are untouched. The probe's transient allocation of at most about 16 MiB is documented as outside admission accounting; this is likely negligible, but it was not verified against the memory ledger. SEC-035's TTFT oracle is unchanged in kind.

No finding. Remaining integration questions are the kernel code itself: probe determinism, fallback to stock on probe failure, and that unrecognized env values cannot select an unprobed kernel. Also unchecked is whether deadline-qualification env checks classify the new key. 37 replay units were omitted from the integration source.
